description: Production Local Studio config after blackwell-forge (2026-09-26): Local Inference Lab R35 vLLM, TP4, native MTP3 (not DFlash2), FP8 fp8_ds_mla KV pinned with --kv-cache-memory-bytes 33285996544 (31 GiB/GPU, skips the profiling graph pass) for a 4,576,303-token pool, 8192 batched tokens, persistent /cache JIT mount, 400k context, 8 sequences, vision with 64 images. Measured at a 275 W/GPU cap: C1 prose 195-214 / code 211-222, C4 ~396, C8 ~440-470 aggregate tok/s, cold 32K prefill 8.7-9.6K tok/s, mixed C4+32K prefill 230. Coherence passed at 279K (336K in X001); vision 32/32 at 1024x768 (X001). Warm relaunch 217 -> 125 s.

metadata.benchmark_workload: blackwell-forge ~/tuning/bench.py on pop-os: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, EOS respected, no max_tokens, unique cold prompts, 30 s windows; decode_tok_s is aggregate completion tok/s over the window, decode_tok_s_per_stream is the per-stream p50; prefill is cold (0 cached tokens) prompt tokens / TTFT; GPUs power-capped at 275 W each, stock clocks.

metadata.deployment_notes: Seed ${CACHE_ROOT}/forge-flash-jit from the image's baked JIT cache before the first launch; the first boot is cold (~217 s), later relaunches ~125 s. The DFlash2 draft mount and DFLASH_* variables are kept as in the controller, but with SPECULATOR=mtp the launcher never reads them. The controller additionally mounts a host dir at /root/.cache; it is left out here because the plugin export allows one scratch mount and /cache carries the JIT cache. Bind raw engine only on a trusted private network. GPUs capped at 275 W.

draft.use: mounted as in the controller but unused while SPECULATOR=mtp; set SPECULATOR=dflash2 to switch back

metadata.history_policy: Standalone Compose proxy or Local Studio controller prunes older images to 8 while protecting the latest user message and subsequent tool results. Raw engine Docker launch alone does not provide this proxy policy or API authentication.
metadata.limits: 400k is the per-request ceiling. Pool is 4,576,303 tokens (11.44x at 400k). The pinned KV bytes skip vLLM's over-estimated graph reserve; watch long-uptime stability. Coherence verified to 279K on this config (336K on X001 at util 0.93).

ladder.verdict: replaced by MTP3 (X001 won every cell)
kept: cold prefill 4.7-8.7K -> 8.7-9.6K, decode within noise
